name: MOSS Image (SFT)
notes: OpenMOSS's 5B text-to-image model (Apache-2.0), with the Flux.2 VAE and Qwen3.5-9B as text encoder. SFT is the tuned version: cleaner text and layouts than Base.
Settings (OpenMOSS): 50 steps, cfg 3 (up to 6 for a short prompt), euler, 1 to 2 MP in multiples of 16. ComfyUI's template runs faster: 25 steps, cfg 2.5, er_sde / simple.
Shift 5 is built in. To change it use ModelSamplingAuraFlow or ModelSamplingFlux: ModelSamplingSD3 uses another scale and turns the picture to noise.
Skip Layer Guidance DiT Simple on layer 22 (single_layers) keeps fine details from falling apart. Off looks a little more real but details can collapse; it can overblow anime.
Put text you want written in quotes. Natural sentences, tags and JSON layouts all work. Negative that helps: nsfw, worst quality, bad anatomy, watermark, jpeg artifact.
Needs a ComfyUI with native MOSS-Image (the dev branch after 0.41.3, 2026-10-16). The MOSS-Image plugin reads OpenMOSS's own checkpoints, not these files.
Turbo: the 8-step DMD LoRA (MOSS_Image_SFT_8_steps_dmd) on the model at 1.0: 8 steps, cfg 1, no skip layer guidance. About 4 s at 1 MP on a 5090.
source: Hugging Face tree API sizes (Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image, prithivMLmods/Qwen3.5-9B-Uncensored-ComfyUI) and the OpenMOSS model card + user guide, 2026-10-18. Tested 2026-10-18 on ComfyUI master 446ef4e00 (Goliath 5090): 50 steps cfg 3 + SLG 22 at 1 MP 32 s with load; DMD LoRA 8 steps cfg 1 4 s.
